english.note: Use 電影 as the all-purpose word for a movie or feature film.
This is the all-purpose term for film as a medium or the movies generally.
Use this all-purpose word when referring to films collectively rather than to a theatre.
Use this when “picture” means cinema or films as entertainment rather than a still image.
